anchor.quote: maps to a rank-3 tensor with diagonal components carrying primary strengths

claims.rationale: Six Shadbala components form at most a vector absent further structure; rank-three tensors do not use rank-two diagonal/off-diagonal language, and no transformation law is defined.

legacy.quote: "maps to a rank-3 tensor with diagonal components carrying primary strengths"
legacy.note: Six component scores are a vector summed to a scalar; a rank-3 tensor has n³ components and a transformation law; "diagonal/off-diagonal" describes rank-2 — botched definition. (The "stress-energy tensor" parallel rides on this error; analogy-framed, folded here.)

anchor.quote: The total Shadbala (scalar) is the tensor trace

legacy.quote: "The total Shadbala (scalar) is the tensor trace"
legacy.note: The trace of a rank-3 tensor is not a scalar; the Shadbala total is an arithmetic sum, not a contraction.
